method: Same 50,000-face decimated proxies as P3-SAM. Stage 1: partfield_inference.py (configs/final/demo.yaml, continue_ckpt model/model_objaverse.ckpt, dataset.val_num_workers 0) - samples 100,000 surface points, predicts a triplane feature field, exports per-face features + the re-exported input PLY (face order preserved). Stage 2: run_part_clustering.py --use_agglo True --max_num_clusters 20 --option 1 --with_knn True (the README's setting for AI-generated/messy meshes) - exports a hierarchy of per-face label arrays for 1..20 clusters; scored at the 10-cluster level for both meshes.

outputs.fetched_to_vm: ~/workspace/gui-test-shots/assetforge/p2-seg/partfield/<mesh>/ (input.ply, labels_06/10/14.npy, colored_06/10/14.glb rebuilt locally with a sequential tab20 palette, colored_10.ply as exported by PartField)
outputs.key_files: exp_results/clustering/seg/cluster_out/<uid>_0_NN.npy = per-face labels (int64, aligned to the faces of exp_results/partfield_features/seg/input_<uid>_0.ply, which preserves the input mesh's face order); exp_results/clustering/seg/ply/<uid>_0_NN.ply = same labels as PLY face colors
outputs.label_id_note: The .npy values are agglomerative cluster NODE ids (e.g. 7544, 15356, 27718), not 0..K-1 - remap the K unique values to 0..K-1 before use. (A naive id%20 palette collides; the spatial breakdown in scores.md was used to verify distinctness.)
outputs.renders: ~/workspace/gui-test-shots/assetforge/p2-seg/partfield/<mesh>/renders10/ (front/back/side/threequarter at the 10-cluster level, Blender Cycles CPU; colors rebuilt from labels_10.npy with a collision-free sequential palette)

runs.verdict_reason: All four legs carry labels distinct from the belly label and from each other, with boundaries at shoulder/hip height; belly is its own label; head+frill is its own label. The leg<->belly test PASSES outright (four distinct legs = the 'better' outcome in the rubric). Caveats: the torso is split into transverse bands at this level (front/mid/rear body labels instead of one trunk), and one leg label's region rides high (up-range to 0.68 - thigh/shoulder included). A pipeline would merge the trunk bands or pick a coarser hierarchy level for the body.
